mandarin: 学习外语离不开好的词典。

mandarin: 一阵大风吹来，把门关上了。

mandarin: 湿润的风从南方吹来。

mandarin: 经济知识对于理解这个问题是至关重要的。

mandarin: 东边地平线上的一道淡红光线使我知道天快要亮了。

mandarin: 狮子长着黄褐色棕毛。

mandarin: 逐字翻译不一定最接近原义。

mandarin: 议会开会的第一天，新政府中的一位部长就和反对党的一位议员争论起来。

mandarin: 一只老鼠从黑暗的洞口跑出。

mandarin: 新的税收制度将于明年实行。

mandarin: 规范语法阐述的是该派语法学家认为的某语言的口语或书面语的标准形式.

mandarin: 已经出现了一些问题.

mandarin: 一位护士来给他包上干净的绷带。

mandarin: 猪是一种家畜。

english: A plantain is similar to a banana.
mandarin: 大蕉类似于香蕉。

english: A portiere was hanging in front of the door.
mandarin: 门前挂着一幅门帘。

mandarin: 在阴凉处休息会使你凉爽。

mandarin: 谣传近期鸡蛋要涨价。

english: A sick person is often feeble.
mandarin: 病人常常虚弱无力。

mandarin: 父辈应当被尊重。

english: A smile often denotes pleasure and friendship.
mandarin: 微笑常常表示高兴和友善。

mandarin: 正方形有四条边，而圆形没有边。

mandarin: 学生应该始终具有强烈的求知欲。

mandarin: 风向的突然转变预示着暴风雨即将来临。

mandarin: 如果班上的人数多，老师就不能给予个别辅导了。

english: A theatre evening (ie an evening at the theatre) has been arranged
mandarin: 已安排好一个戏剧晚会.

english: A vibrating membrane in the ear helps to convey sounds to the brain.
mandarin: 耳膜的振动帮助声音传送到大脑。

mandarin: 一个侍者给他端来一杯稀咖啡。

mandarin: 起风了, 雨点忽然落下来。

mandarin: 有个年幼的学生在炎炎烈日下晕倒了。

mandarin: 对他来说，非洲是一片神秘的土地。

mandarin: 经过连续几次的失败，他最后终于通过了驾驶考试。

mandarin: 请假离开办公室之后我赶紧去了医院。

mandarin: 从他领导后，一个又一个革新项目出现了。

mandarin: 早饭后，他读了各种报纸。

mandarin: 游泳后，她用毛巾擦干身子。

english: After much delay, he finished his paper at last.
mandarin: 拖了那么久，他终于完成了论文。

english: After so much dry weather, the rain has been the farmer's salvation.
mandarin: 天气干旱了这么久，这场雨成了农民的救星。

english: After the alien spacecraft had hovered over the park for a short time, it vanished.
mandarin: 那只外星来的宇宙飞船在公园上空盘旋了一会儿之后就不见了。

english: After the play they called for the author to show himself.
mandarin: 演完戏之后, 他们要求作者出来和大家见面。

english: After their divorce, the father was awarded custody of the son.
mandarin: 离婚以后，孩子由父亲监护。

english: After these dry days, everyone hopes for rain.
mandarin: 干燥的天气之后，人人都希望下雨。

mandarin: 步行了四个小时以后，我们开始累了。

mandarin: 工作了十五个小时之后，我开始感到累了。

english: Agriculture in this country has developed greatly after liberation.
mandarin: 解放后这个国家的农业得到了巨大的发展。

english: Ah, well, it take all kinds!
mandarin: 啊，好啦，一样白米养百样人嘛。

english: Alcoholics often suffer from periods of oblivion.
mandarin: 饮酒过度的人常常失去记忆。

english: All kinds of human experience testify to the close link between love and fear.
mandarin: 人类的种种经验都证明了爱与怕之间的紧密联系。

english: All passengers are required to show their tickets.
mandarin: 所有乘客都必须出示车票。

english: All plants need water and light.
mandarin: 所有的植物都需要水和阳光。

english: All that heavy lifting has given me a pain in the back
mandarin: 我一直抬那些重东西, 现在腰都痛了.

english: All the applicants were interviewed one by one.
mandarin: 所有的申请者一个接着一个参加面试。

english: All the boys in the class want to go out with the pretty girl.
mandarin: 班里所有的男孩都想陪这个漂亮的女孩一起出游。

english: All the female workers in this factory got a present on March 8.
mandarin: 这家工厂的所有女职工在三八节都得到了一份礼物。

english: All the goodness has been boiled off the vegetables.
mandarin: 这些蔬菜中的营养部分全都给煮掉了。

english: All the lights flickered for a moment.
mandarin: 所有的灯都闪了一会儿。

english: All the ships in the vicinity of the crash joined in the search for survivors.
mandarin: 撞船事故发生地区的所有船只都参加了搜寻幸存者的工作。

english: All the windows were bricked up.
mandarin: 所有的窗户都用砖堵住了。

english: All this is totally unnecessary.
mandarin: 所有这些完全都是多余的。

english: All those who are immediately involved will be informed of the decision.
mandarin: 这个决定将被通知给所有直接有关的人。

english: Although many people opposed his plan, he engineered it through to final approval.
mandarin: 虽然很多人反对他的计划，他仍能巧妙地设法使它最后获得通过。

english: Although our looks differ, we are both attractive.
mandarin: 尽管我俩相貌不同，但都讨人喜欢。

english: Altogether we caught ten golden monkeys.
mandarin: 我们一共捉到10只金丝猴。

english: An airplane alighted on the airdrome.
mandarin: 一架飞机在机场着陆。

english: An electric current in metal is caused by the movement of electrons.
mandarin: 金属内电流是由电子运动引起的。

english: Analyze the sentence into its constituent parts.
mandarin: 把这条句子的各个成份加以分析。

english: And now the scene shifts to the warehouse, where the murderer is lying in wait.
mandarin: 现在场景转到仓库，行凶者正埋伏在那里伺机行动。

mandarin: 再呆10个星期，一共3个月。

english: Apostles were sent out by Christ to spread his teachings.
mandarin: 基督派基督十二使徒之一宣传他的教义。

english: Applicants will be notified of our decision in good season.
mandarin: 我们会把决定及早通知申请者。

english: April is the time to plant trees.
mandarin: 四月是种树的时候。

english: Artillery was deployed in the west
mandarin: 炮兵部署在西边.

mandarin: 通常, 是男士伸出手来邀请女士跳舞。

mandarin: 就我而言，我并不反对你的计划。

english: As he grew up he passed on his clothes to his younger brother.
mandarin: 他长大了，穿剩下的衣服就给了他的弟弟。

mandarin: 他由于忘了带钥匙，便以简单的应急办法从窗户爬进屋里。

english: As he turned the knob, the sound diminished.
mandarin: 他一转旋钮，声音就变小了。

english: As I had plenty of money I was able to help her.

mandarin: 随着逐渐成熟，许多年轻的激进分子对 生活和社会渐持较为宽容的态度。

mandarin: 请医生开点咳嗽药.

mandarin: 占星家声称能预知祸福.

english: At the end of the party, we thanked our host and went away.

mandarin: 恰恰就在我登上公共汽车踏板的时候，车子开动了。

english: Better late than never.

mandarin: 把蔬菜煮上20分钟，然后把水沥掉。

mandarin: 从资料库借磁带是退而求其次的办法。

mandarin: 我姐姐和我都喜欢穿牛仔裤。

mandarin: 巴西出口大量咖啡。

mandarin: 面包主要是由面粉做成的。

mandarin: 各商行互相竞争以招揽顾客。

mandarin: 他十岁的时候就已经长得比他哥哥高了。

english: Cacti live in dry regions.
mandarin: 仙人掌生长在干旱地区。

english: Candidates who fail to meet these requirements will not be admitted to the University.
mandarin: 不符合这些要求的考生不能上这所大学。

english: Careful people usually put everything in good order.
mandarin: 细心的人总是把东西放得很整齐。

english: Cares preyed upon her health.
mandarin: 忧虑损害了她的健康。

english: Cars and trolleys filled the streets.
mandarin: 汽车和电车塞满了整条街。

english: Certainly they must know the probable result of such speeches.
mandarin: 无疑，他们一定知道这样讲话可能产生的后果。

english: Certainly, if the weather is fine.
mandarin: 如果天气好，当然可以。

mandarin: 查理一世统治英国11年。

english: Children like outdoor activities.
mandarin: 孩子们喜欢户外活动。

english: Children's shoes aren't cheap quite the reverse
mandarin: 儿童的鞋并不便宜--反而更贵.

english: China does a lot of trade with many countries.
mandarin: 中国和许多国家进行多方面贸易。

english: China is a country rich in crude oil.
mandarin: 中国是一个原油丰富的国家。

english: China is a developing country.
mandarin: 中国是一个发展中国家。

english: China is an oriental country with a long history.
mandarin: 中国是一个有着悠久历史的东方国家。

english: Chinese children like to buy many firecrackers before the Spring Festival.
mandarin: 中国孩子会在春节前买很多鞭炮。

english: Chinese people are working hard to make the country richer and more beautiful.
mandarin: 中国人民正在努力工作，把国家建设得更加富饶美丽。

mandarin: 肖邦的乐曲唤起了她极其复杂的感情。

mandarin: 圣诞节是基督教的节日。

mandarin: 圣诞节是基督教徒的一个重要节日。

mandarin: 开出鲜艳花朵的爬藤植物瀑布般悬挂在花园墙上。

english: Clouds are banking up.
mandarin: 云层正在堆积。

english: Color flags added to the gaiety of the festival.
mandarin: 彩旗增加了节日的欢乐。

english: Come on over to have a try.
mandarin: 你过来试试看。

english: Considering the smallness of the car, it is relatively roomy inside
mandarin: 别看这辆汽车小, 里面还比较宽敞.

english: Continuous assessment is made of all students' work.
mandarin: 对全体学生的功课作出连贯性的评定。

english: Cotton catches fire easily.
mandarin: 棉花容易着火。

english: Crowds massed along the road where the king would pass.
mandarin: 群众聚集在国王要经过的街道旁。

english: Cut the bread into small rounds and give me two.
mandarin: 把面包切成小片，然后给我两片。

english: Damn! I've lost my umbrella.
mandarin: 糟糕!我把伞丢了。

english: Despite all our efforts we still lost the game.
mandarin: 尽管我们尽了全力，我们还是输掉了比赛。

english: Despite his cries no one came to his assistance.
mandarin: 尽管他大声喊叫，却没有人来帮助他。

english: Do keep quiet or you'll throw me out in my calculations.
mandarin: 你可得安静点儿了，要不然我没法计算了。

english: Do not fear; I will support you.
mandarin: 别担心，我会支持你的。

mandarin: 码头工人开始卸货。

mandarin: 在西方极乐世界，大夫们比我们当将军的可能还要负更多人命之责吧。

mandarin: 多丽，你的东西乱七八糟，收拾收拾房间。

mandarin: 别都挤在一块儿, 分开坐吧.

english: Don't all speak at the same time
mandarin: 大家别同时说.

mandarin: 别那么敏感，我不是在批评你。

english: Don't bother.
mandarin: 不用麻烦了。

mandarin: 别哭，你现在已经是大男孩了。

mandarin: 别忘了带上你的钓具。

english: Don't forget to keep a careful tally of what you spend.
mandarin: 别忘了仔细记下你的开支帐目。

mandarin: 不要嘲笑他。

mandarin: 别让她在外边雨中等著.

english: Don't let me down.
mandarin: 别让我失望。

mandarin: 不要干涉别人的事情。

mandarin: 你走时别忘了锁门。

mandarin: 别把热水倒进玻璃杯里，不然它会炸的。

english: Don't rake up the past.
mandarin: 不要把过去的事都翻出来。

mandarin: 别那样对我大声嚷嚷，我能听清楚。

english: Don't stand on ceremony. I'm no stranger.
mandarin: 别客气，我又不是外人。

english: Don't trample on the grass.
mandarin: 不要践踏草地。

mandarin: 别相信他，他像老狐狸一样狡猾。

mandarin: 别穿这些衣服去工作，要穿得象个专业人员的样子。

mandarin: 别为几个差错着急，迟早一切都会得到圆满解决的。

english: Don't worry if the shoes seem a bit tight at first; the leather has plenty of give in it

english: He left behind an immortal example to all posterity.
mandarin: 他给后世留下了不朽的典范。

english: He likes playing jokes on his classmates.
mandarin: 他喜欢拿他的同学开玩笑。

english: He likes to throw the bull.
mandarin: 他喜欢吹牛。

english: He lingered outside the school after everybody else had gone home.
mandarin: 别人回家后，他仍在学校外面徘徊。

english: He lit the candles on the birthday cake.
mandarin: 他点燃了生日蛋糕上的小蜡烛。

english: He lives in a cosy little room.
mandarin: 他住在一个舒适的小屋里。

english: He looked in the glass to check that his tie was straight
mandarin: 他对著镜子看领带是否系正.

english: He looked rather out of place when he turned up in full ceremonial rig.
mandarin: 当他穿着全套大礼服露面的时候，显得和整个场合很不协调。

english: He lost one of the pieces of his model engine
mandarin: 他的火车头模型缺了一个零件.

english: He made oblique references to her lack of experience.
mandarin: 他拐弯抹角地说她缺乏经验。

english: He majored in comparative literature.
mandarin: 他的专业是比较文学。

english: He mastered these words through the arduous consultation of the dictionary.
mandarin: 通过勤查字典，他掌握了这些单词。

english: He moaned about his misfortunes to anyone who would listen.
mandarin: 他向每一个愿意听的人抱怨他的不幸。

english: He moved like a tiger stalking its prey.
mandarin: 他像老虎一样悄悄潜近他的猎物。

english: He moves in exclusive social circles and belongs to the most exclusive clubs.
mandarin: 他活动于社交甚严的社交圈内，而且属于那些最不愿吸收外人的俱乐部。

english: He must have drunk too much; when he tried to stand up, he keeled over.
mandarin: 他肯定是喝多了，当他要站起来时，却摔倒在地上。

english: He needs a high income to support such a large family.
mandarin: 他需要有高收入才能供养得起这样一个大家庭。

english: He never goes on a vacation but he takes his pet dog.
mandarin: 他每次度假都会带他的狗去。

english: He often does his wife's bidding.
mandarin: 他经常按他妻子的吩咐去做。

english: He opened the window to let out the foul air.
mandarin: 他打开窗户，放出污浊的空气。

english: He oscillates between political extremes
mandarin: 他的政治观点在两个极端之间摇摆不定.

english: He passed judgement on the guilty man.
mandarin: 他对那个罪犯做出了裁决。

english: He persuaded his daughter to change her mind
mandarin: 他说服女儿改变主意.

english: He planted some flowers on the balcony that projects over the street.
mandarin: 他在那个伸出到街上的阳台上种了些花。

english: He pounced on my offer.
mandarin: 他欣然接受了我的报价。

english: He poured some wine into the goblet.
mandarin: 他向高脚酒杯里倒了一些葡萄酒。

english: He purposed to visit South America.
mandarin: 他计划去南美。

english: He pushed me and I fell over.
mandarin: 他推我，我跌了下来。

english: He put forward a new theory.
mandarin: 他提出了一种新理论。

english: He put on a thick sweater since it was cold in the morning.
mandarin: 早晨很冷，他穿上了一件厚毛衣。

english: He put some grass in the manger.
mandarin: 他在食槽里放了些草。

english: He raised his arm to protect his child from hurt.
mandarin: 他伸出手去，保护他的孩子免受伤害。

english: He raises some strange questions now and again.
mandarin: 他时常提出一些奇怪的问题。

english: He redeemed several coupons at the store.
mandarin: 他从商店里得到了几张优惠券。

english: He remembered her parting kiss in the following years.
mandarin: 在以后的岁月中，他一直记着她临别时的一吻。

english: He returned from Paris and found his office was under someone else's occupation.
mandarin: 他从巴黎回来，发现他的办公室被别人占了。

english: He reversed the coin and examined it carefully.
mandarin: 他把硬币倒过来，仔细检查。

english: He rose again from the dust of past defeats.
mandarin: 他过去因失败而蒙羞，现在东山再起了。

english: He rowed the boat across the lake.
mandarin: 他划船渡过湖面。

english: He sat in a draught and catch a cold.
mandarin: 他坐在风口上，着凉了。

english: He saved money bit by bit until he had enough to buy a car
mandarin: 他一点儿一点儿攒钱直到够买一辆汽车.

english: He saved my life at the risk of his own.
mandarin: 他冒着自己的生命危险救了我的命。

english: He scratched his name on the wall with a knife.
mandarin: 他用一把小刀把自己的名字刻在墙上。

english: He seemed somewhat loath to depart.
mandarin: 他似乎不愿离去。

english: He seems much shorter without his shoes on.
mandarin: 他没穿鞋，看上去矮多了。

english: He seems to have mistaken a plus for a minus.
mandarin: 他似乎把正号误作负号了。

english: He shook his head, for he thought differently.
mandarin: 他摇摇头，因为他的想法与此不同。

english: He should listen to his intimate feelings.
mandarin: 人应当倾听自己的内心感觉。

english: He showed a lot of pluck to leave a safe job and set up his own business.
mandarin: 他放弃了一份安定的工作而自己创业，表现出了极大的勇气。

english: He showed great moderation in not responding angrily to the attacks on his character.
mandarin: 他忍受对自己人品的攻击而不发火，表现出巨大的自我控制能力。

english: He showed remarkable courage when he faced the danger.
mandarin: 他在面对危险的时候表现出非凡的勇气。

english: He sings treble.
mandarin: 他唱最高音部。

english: He slammed the papers down on my desk and angrily walked out.
mandarin: 他把文件使劲扔在我的桌子上便怒气冲冲地走了出去。

english: He soon gets accustom to dormitory life and make two or three friend.
mandarin: 他不久就逐渐习惯了宿舍的生活并交了两三个朋友。

english: He spares no pains to study English.
mandarin: 他不辞劳苦地学习英语。

english: He speaks not only English but also French.
mandarin: 他不但会说英语，而且还会说法语。

english: He sprinkled vinegar on his fish and chips.
mandarin: 他把醋洒在鱼和土豆片上。

english: He stammers when he feels nervous.
mandarin: 他一紧张就结巴。

english: He started off at a run but soon tired and slowed to a walk.
mandarin: 他跑步出发，但很快就累得慢下来成了步行。

english: He started work here last June.
mandarin: 他是去年六月开始在这里工作的。

english: He stayed in the background to escape from the public attention.
mandarin: 他呆在幕后为了避开公众的注意。

english: He stayed one night in a motel and went on travelling.
mandarin: 他在一家汽车旅馆呆了一晚上，就又接着旅行了。

english: He steamed the stamp off the envelope.
mandarin: 他用蒸汽把信封上的邮票揭下来。

english: He steered the car skillfully through the narrow streets.
mandarin: 他熟练地驾驶着汽车穿过狭窄的街道。

english: He still reserved his opinion on some points.
mandarin: 在一些问题上，他仍然保留自己的意见。

english: He stood framed in the doorway to the hall
mandarin: 他站在门口, 堵住通向大厅的路.

english: He studies Chinese as well.
mandarin: 他也学习汉语。

english: He swore to love her for evermore.
mandarin: 他发誓永远爱她。

english: He talked to her with persuasive manner.
mandarin: 他以晓之以礼的态度劝说她。

english: He threw a stone into the lake.
mandarin: 他向湖里扔了一块石头。

english: He told a very descriptive account of his journey.
mandarin: 他对旅行作了十分生动的叙述。

english: He told me the news with a laugh.
mandarin: 他笑着告诉我这个消息。

english: He told the newspapermen about the conversation, but would not play them the actual tape of it.
mandarin: 他向新闻记者讲了这次谈话的情况，却不愿把实况录音磁带放给他们听。

english: He told the photographers to stop pestering him
mandarin: 他告诉照相的人别再缠著他.

english: He told us with a smile of contentment.
mandarin: 他带着心满意足的微笑告诉了我们。

english: He took my ace with a low trump.
mandarin: 他用一张小的王牌吃了我的A牌。

english: He took out a book from the case.
mandarin: 他从箱子里拿出一本书。

english: He trundled a wheelbarrow down the path.
mandarin: 他推着手推车沿路走过。

english: He turned around as he heard a noise behind him.
mandarin: 他听到身后有响声，便转过身来。

english: He turned off the light and the room was in complete darkness.
mandarin: 他关上了灯，室内一片漆黑。

english: He undertook to finish the job by Friday.
mandarin: 他答应星期五之前完成这项工作。

english: He urged the horses on with a whip.
mandarin: 他用鞭子策马前行。

english: He wanted to find some wine in the pantry.
mandarin: 他想在餐具室里找到一些酒。

english: He wants to be a doctor or go into business
mandarin: 他想当医生或者经商.

english: He warned me against going there at night.
mandarin: 他警告我晚上不要到那去。

english: He was a dishonor to his regiment.
mandarin: 他是那个团的耻辱。

english: He was admitted to the Party last year.
mandarin: 他去年入党了。

english: He was asked the same question so many times that the answer became mechanical.
mandarin: 同样的问题人们向他问得太多了，所以他的答案也是千篇一律。

english: He was attacked by a wild boar.
mandarin: 他被一头野猪袭击。

english: He was bashed up in the playground by some older boys
mandarin: 有几个年龄较大的男孩子在操场上对他动武.

english: He was black and blue all over.
mandarin: 他遍体鳞伤。

english: He was criticized by the committee for failing to report the accident.
mandarin: 他因未对事故进行汇报而受到委员会的批评。

english: He was fettered by his family and could not travel any longer.
mandarin: 他被家庭束缚，不能再到处去旅游了。

english: He was filled with envy at my success.
mandarin: 他对我的成功满怀羡慕。

english: He was filled with horror at the bad news.
mandarin: 听到这个坏消息，他心里充满恐怖。

english: He was fined 200 dollars.
mandarin: 他被罚款200美元。

english: He was fired by his boss.
mandarin: 他被他的老板解雇了。

english: He was gone and left all the work undone to me.
mandarin: 他走了，把所有没做完的工作都留给了我。

english: He was impudent enough to call me a fool.
mandarin: 他无礼至极，竟然叫我傻瓜。

english: He was lying on the sofa watching TV
mandarin: 他躺在沙发上看电视.

english: He was nervous before the plane trip.
mandarin: 乘飞机旅行前他紧张不安。

english: He was seduced into leaving the company by the offer of higher pay elsewhere.
mandarin: 其他地方更优厚的薪金待遇诱使他离开了公司。

english: He was seeded number 1.
mandarin: 他被定为一号种子选手。

english: He was sent into prison for stealing.
mandarin: 他由于偷窃被送入监狱。

english: He was the first to be there.
mandarin: 他是第一个到达那里的。

english: He was thirsty for power.
mandarin: 他渴望拥有权力。

english: He was unconscious of his mistake.
mandarin: 他没意识到自己犯了错误。

english: He was very conscious of his shortcomings.
mandarin: 他对自己的缺点十分清楚。

english: He wears an oily old pair of jeans.
mandarin: 他穿着一条沾满油污的旧牛仔裤。

english: He went to school without breakfast. (=He went to school and did not eat breakfast.)
mandarin: 他没吃早饭就去上学了。

english: He went to the post-office to buy some stamps.
mandarin: 他去邮局买些邮票。

english: He will certainly die if you don't call a doctor
mandarin: 你不请大夫来, 他就得死了.

english: He will go down in history as a great statesman.
mandarin: 他将作为伟大的政治家而载入史册。

english: He winced as she stood on his injured foot.
mandarin: 她踩着他受伤的脚，他疼得缩了回去。

english: He won many hearts by his gallantry.
mandarin: 他以勇敢赢得芳心无数。

english: He won the golf match by two shots.
mandarin: 他以两杆的成绩赢得了这场高尔夫球赛。

english: He worked out an excellent idea.
mandarin: 他想出了一个极好的主意。

english: He works in a secondary school.
mandarin: 他在一所中学工作。

english: He wrote down his name on the list.
mandarin: 他将他的名字写在清单上。

english: He wrung his hands in sorrow.
mandarin: 他悲伤地绞紧双手。

english: He yawned, rubbed his eyes and went into the front room.
mandarin: 他打了个呵欠，揉了揉眼睛，就到前边屋里去了。

english: He yearned to return to his native land.
mandarin: 他渴望回到故乡。

english: He's always full of cheer in summer.
mandarin: 夏天他总是高高兴兴的。

english: He's got a pretty strange conception of friendship.
mandarin: 他对友谊有一种非常独特的见解。

english: He's lost a lot of weight: he's three kilos lighter than he used to be
mandarin: 他体重减了很多, 比以前轻了三公斤.

english: He's so boring that I always try to give him a wide berth at parties
mandarin: 他这个人很没意思, 在聚会上我总是对他退避三舍.

english: He's so clever, he makes me feel inferior.
mandarin: 他是那么聪明，使我自愧不如。

english: He's too mean to buy us a meal.
mandarin: 他太小气，不肯请我们吃饭。

english: Heavy snow hindered the construction work.
mandarin: 大雪妨碍了这项建筑工程的进行。

english: Her baby has bonny and bright blue eyes.
mandarin: 她的孩子有一双美丽而明亮的蓝眼睛。

english: Her beauty enslaved many young men.
mandarin: 她的美貌倾倒了很多男青年。

english: Her exam result was disappointing but she tried to put a brave face on it.
mandarin: 她的考试成绩令人失望，但却装出若无其事的样子。

english: Her face lit up when she saw he was coming.
mandarin: 当她看到他走过来的时候，她的脸亮了起来。

english: Her gentleness has given me a deep impression.
mandarin: 她的亲切给我留下了很深的印象。

english: Her kerchief is dirty with oil.
mandarin: 她的围巾被油弄脏了。

english: Her most essential quality is kindness.
mandarin: 她最主要的品质是善良。

english: Her mother is a thrifty housewife.
mandarin: 她妈妈是一个节俭的主妇。

english: Her refusal to help complicates matters.
mandarin: 她不肯帮忙，事情就更难办了。

english: Her scientific bias showed itself in early childhood.
mandarin: 她在科学方面的倾向性在孩童时代就已显现出来。

english: Her speeches have ever been a fount of inspiration to her audiences.
mandarin: 她的演说对于听众来说永远是灵感之源。

english: Her wiry athletic body seems energetic.
mandarin: 她瘦长结实的身体看上去精力充沛。

english: Herein lies the real danger.
mandarin: 这其中含有真正的危险。

english: Higher mortgage rates are partly offset by increased tax allowances.
mandarin: 抵押款提高了，其中一部分可由免税额增加而抵消。

english: His ability carried him to the top of his profession.
mandarin: 他有才干能在本行业中首屈一指。

english: His behavior called forth sharp criticism.
mandarin: 他的行为招致尖锐的批评。

english: His book came out last month.
mandarin: 他的书上个月出版了。

english: His busy schedule made him completely inaccessible to his students.
mandarin: 他的时间排得很满，学生根本无法和他接触。

english: His costly mistake resulted in severe loss.
mandarin: 他的严重的错误导致了重大的损失。

english: His death was a great shock to us all.
mandarin: 他的死使我们大家都大为震惊。

english: His dream came true.
mandarin: 他的梦想实现了。

english: His enthusiasm breathed new life into the company.
mandarin: 他的热情给公司注入了新的生命。

english: His experience has a slow maturity.
mandarin: 他的经验缓慢地成熟。

english: His eyes shifted to the telephone.
mandarin: 他的眼光转向了电话机。

english: His eyes smart at the smoke.
mandarin: 他的眼睛被烟熏痛了。

english: His father insisted that they (should) move to the country.
mandarin: 他爸爸坚持他们应该搬到乡下。

english: His French has come on a lot since he joined the conversation class.
mandarin: 他自从参加了会话班，法语取得了很大进步。

english: His hair has been cut short.
mandarin: 他的头发已剪短了。

english: His handling of the meeting was quite a virtuoso performance
mandarin: 他掌握会议可真有一套.

english: His head throbbed with pain.
mandarin: 他的头一阵阵地痛。

english: His heart melted when he saw the little girl crying.
mandarin: 看到这个小女孩哭起来，他的心软了。

english: His house looks terrible with those pieces of ugly furniture.
mandarin: 那些难看的家具使得他的家看上去一团糟糕。

english: His illness was more serious than the doctor first thought.
mandarin: 他的病较医生原来以为的更严重。

english: His interest in learning Japanese has petered out.
mandarin: 他学习日语的兴趣逐渐消失了。

english: His left arm was hurt in an accident.
mandarin: 他的左胳膊在一次事故中受伤了。

english: His manner partakes of insolence.
mandarin: 他的态度带有几分傲慢。

english: His manner was cold and indifferent.
mandarin: 他的态度既冷淡又无动于衷。

english: His new film was really panned by the critics.
mandarin: 他新拍摄的电影确实受到评论家严厉的批评。

english: His only recreations are drinking beer and working in the garden.
mandarin: 他仅有的消遣是喝啤酒和在花园里种花草。

english: His opinion doesn't carry much weight.
mandarin: 他的意见没多少影响。

english: His pain is past now.
mandarin: 他的痛苦现在已经过去。

english: His paintings are on display at the exhibition.
mandarin: 他的绘画正在展览会上展出。

english: His past is enveloped in a shroud of mystery.
mandarin: 他过去的经历笼罩着神秘气氛。

english: His pictures were showed in the gallery.
mandarin: 他的画在画廊展出。

english: His plans were transformed overnight into reality.
mandarin: 他的计划迅速变为现实。

english: His poetry was published last year.
mandarin: 他的诗集去年发表了。

english: His proposition is good in theory but cannot be put into practice.
mandarin: 他的建议在理论上可以, 但不能付诸实现。

english: His recent death overshadowed the family gathering.
mandarin: 他最近去世给家庭聚会蒙上了阴影。

english: His refusal iced our enthusiasm.
mandarin: 他的拒绝浇熄了我们的热情。

english: His reply was taken half seriously, half in jest
mandarin: 他的答覆看来是半开玩笑半认真的.

english: His secret died with him, for he never told anyone.
mandarin: 他的秘密至死也不为人知，因为他从未告诉过别人。

english: His songs are full of dirge.
mandarin: 他的歌充满了忧伤。

english: His speech won the applause of the audience.
mandarin: 他的讲话赢得了听众的掌声。

english: His success was achieved by hard work
mandarin: 他靠辛勤劳动而获得成功.

english: His talk about apartheid created agitation.
mandarin: 他的关于种族隔离的谈话激起了骚动。

english: His uncle instructed him in French.
mandarin: 他的叔叔教他法语。

english: His valour in the war was seen by everybody.
mandarin: 他在战争中的英勇人所共见。

english: His victory was celebrated with music and dancing.
mandarin: 以音乐和舞蹈庆祝他的胜利。

english: His view of life is different from yours.
mandarin: 他的人生观与你的不同。

english: His words were followed by a pregnant pause.
mandarin: 他说完话，接着是一段意味深长的停顿。

english: Histories are often warped by biases.
mandarin: 历史常为偏见所曲解。

english: How much money I earn is none of your concern.
mandarin: 我挣多少钱与你无关。

english: How should I know.
mandarin: 我怎么知道。

english: Human happiness is so fragile.
mandarin: 人生幸福易逝。

english: Hunger begets crime.
mandarin: 饥饿引起犯罪。

english: I ache all over.
mandarin: 我浑身疼痛。

english: I always confuse the sisters: they look so alike
mandarin: 我总是分不出这对姐妹, 她们看上去简直一模一样.

english: I always feel he has a grudge against me, although I don't know why.
mandarin: 我总觉得他讨厌我，但我不知道为什么。

english: I always tell my daughter a story before she goes to sleep.
mandarin: 女儿睡觉之前，我总讲故事给她听。

english: I am a broadcasting auditor.
mandarin: 我是一名广播电台的听众。

english: I am a hundred percent in agreement with you.
mandarin: 我百分之百同意你的看法。

english: I am always interested in psychology.
mandarin: 我一直对心理学感兴趣。

mandarin: 让我记下你的地址和电话号码。

mandarin: 咱们考虑一下搬家的利弊吧。

mandarin: 咱们来把它们用胶水粘在一块儿。

mandarin: 生命可以被比作一次不知目的地的旅行。

english: Life in the country is rather delightful.
mandarin: 乡村生活确实让人愉快。

mandarin: 对他来说，生活似乎已失去了一切乐趣。

mandarin: 听音乐对她起了一种镇静的作用。

mandarin: 小孩有柔软的身体。

mandarin: 龙虾有八条腿两条爪子。

mandarin: 爱情不分贫富。

mandarin: 出门之前把窗户关严。

mandarin: 精神病院常雇用男护士护理精神病人.

mandarin: 人类是在幼年开始学习第一种语言的。

mandarin: 许多富商靠极其残酷地践踏别人而爬了上去。

mandarin: 许多疾病是由细菌引起的。

mandarin: 很多农民离开农村转事工业劳动.

mandarin: 各种各样的影响有助于塑造我们的孩子们的性格。

mandarin: 很多种类的动物现在已经从地球上绝迹了。

mandarin: 这大概正是我要做的。

mandarin: 陪审团的全体成员，你们现在必须退下去考虑应如何裁决。

mandarin: 金属遇热则膨胀。

mandarin: 牛奶可制成凝乳。

mandarin: 金钱买不来幸福。

mandarin: 参加考试的人大多数语法及格.

mandarin: 大部分印第安人生活在联邦政府建立的保留地上。

mandarin: 这个地区大多数国家的经济都不稳定。

mandarin: 江河大多流入海洋.

english: Mother has something delicious in store for me.
mandarin: 妈妈准备了好吃的东西给我。

mandarin: 换档时扳动这根操纵杆。

mandarin: 史密斯先生在政府的行政部门工作。

mandarin: 有人指定拉姆奇夫人把钱装在一只纸盒子里，并把纸板盒放在她的门外边。

mandarin: 史密斯夫人教那些快五岁的儿童。

mandarin: 音乐学生学习给一个现有的调子配上其他音部，还要学习怎样转成和声调。

mandarin: 我的围裙太脏了，我不得不洗它。

mandarin: 我的弟弟是饲养牛的饲养员。

mandarin: 父亲给我买了一只小狗作为生日礼物。

mandarin: 我妈妈鼓励我，而且坚持我应该继续我的教育。

mandarin: 我母亲已经五十岁了。

mandarin: 我的母亲因我撒谎而愤怒。

mandarin: 我的新家在第十六层。

mandarin: 我的钢笔是新的。

english: My phone was out of order.
mandarin: 我的电话坏了。

mandarin: 我妹妹每周去一次美容院。

mandarin: 我儿子六岁的时候开始学习乘法。

mandarin: 我的表慢五分钟。

mandarin: 我的周末过得很无聊--只是在屋子里 转转或者看看电视.

mandarin: 我的爱人很会做饭。

mandarin: 我妹妹认为，她能极力说服父亲提高她每月的零用钱。

mandarin: 国民财富在很大程度上取决于一个国家的教育水准。

english: Nature is at its best in spring.
mandarin: 春天里万物欣欣向荣。

english: Neither chair is comfortable.
mandarin: 两把椅子坐起来都不舒服。

mandarin: 该学院采用新的外语教学法。

mandarin: 没有人能够成功而不努力。

mandarin: 没有人想碰到麻烦。

mandarin: 噪音令人讨厌，尤其当你想睡觉的时候。

mandarin: 雇用了没参加工会的工人以结束罢工行动.

english: Not everyone likes this book.
mandarin: 并不是每个人都喜欢这本书。

english: Not until eleven o'clock did he come home.
mandarin: 他到十一点才回家。

mandarin: 什么也不能推动一个按钟头收费的人，对他的平静的心情来说，时间的消逝是多么甜蜜啊。

mandarin: 这小镇上什么事也没发生过。

mandarin: 现在就想回去，为了冷却他那急切的心，暂把他送到法国的哥哥家中。

mandarin: 建议肥胖病人改变饮食.

mandarin: 所有的顾问当中, 只有王先生提了一些中肯的建议。

mandarin: 哦，也许我错了。

mandarin: 老年人通常比年轻人保守。

mandarin: 请给我找一个放糖的容器。

mandarin: 请于每段第一行缩格书写。

mandarin: 请别打扰我。

mandarin: 请把面粉和牛奶调至恰当的浓度。

mandarin: 请递给我一张纸巾。

mandarin: 请给我们公司寄一份详细的简历。

english: Please show me the menu.

mandarin: 请把电源关掉。

mandarin: 离开房间前，请把灯关掉。

mandarin: 警方把建筑物的所有出口都封锁住了.

mandarin: 政治和宗教是人们平常交谈的主要话题。

english: Pop stars are always moaning about being mobbed by their fans.
mandarin: 流行歌星总是抱怨他们受到歌迷的包围。

mandarin: 小学教育受地方政府的保护。

mandarin: 史密斯教授曾做过总统的特别顾问。

mandarin: 如果你到今晚把手头上的工作做完，你明天就可以休息。

mandarin: 把你的名字填写在每页上端的括号内。

mandarin: 北京广播电台向全世界播送新闻。

english: Read the text first and then explain the new words.
mandarin: 先读课文，然后解释生词。

english: Real friendship is more valuable than money.
mandarin: 真正的友谊比金钱更宝贵。

mandarin: 最近，许多州坚持中学应该教学生如何开车。

mandarin: 两国关系已达到出现危机的地步。

english: Remember me to your family.
mandarin: 向你全家问好。

mandarin: 土星是依次离太阳的第六颗行星。

mandarin: 他刚刚到达就不得不又离开。

english: School reopens next week.
mandarin: 下周学校复课。

mandarin: 科学家仍在寻求治疗感冒的方法。

english: Searching lights traversed the sky.
mandarin: 探照灯扫过天空。

mandarin: 骑士们在小酒店里会合，讨论他们的计划。

mandarin: 干旱少雨使原本就很严重的粮食短缺问题更加严重。

mandarin: 这一运动的领导层对这个问题的看法一致。

mandarin: 秋天时叶子变黄。

mandarin: 这封信是用正式文体写的。

mandarin: 这封信只用一张纸写成。

mandarin: 自由党候选人轻易获胜，超出选票数以千计。

mandarin: 那个图书馆从上午9点到下午6点开放。

mandarin: 表演正好进行到一半时停电了。

mandarin: 狮子一走近，小动物们都跑开了。

mandarin: 这个小男孩能够数到一千。

mandarin: 这个小男孩跑去找他的哥哥。

mandarin: 那小猫爬到树上却不敢下来。

mandarin: 小猫喝了牛奶，又洗了脸。

mandarin: 这个小女孩因为斜视不敢在公共场合露面。

english: The little girl drowned in the river.
mandarin: 小女孩在河里淹死了。

english: The loft is used for storing things.
mandarin: 这间阁楼是用来存放东西的。

english: The long drought scorched the grass.
mandarin: 久旱使青草枯萎。

english: The loud noise chafed him.
mandarin: 吵闹声使他烦躁。

mandarin: 魔术师从他的帽子里变出一只兔子。

mandarin: 魔术师把青蛙变成了公主。

mandarin: 发展的主要障碍是这个国家人口太多。

mandarin: 男性在身体上要比女性强壮。

mandarin: 那人用斧头把一块木头劈成两半。

mandarin: 那人太阳穴上贴了一块膏药，看上去像个卡通人物。

mandarin: 这个人为了赢得胜利进行了英勇的斗争。

english: The man was so genial, so I was drawn to him at once.
mandarin: 这人这么和蔼, 我立刻为他着迷。

mandarin: 管理部门采取了一切合理的安全措施。

mandarin: 庄园主宅第是一栋环抱在美丽的花园中的大理石房子。

mandarin: 这件事不久引起了一些领导同志的注意。

mandarin: 这辆卡车最大载重量是一吨。

mandarin: 他并没有把这首诗的意义真正揭示出来.

english: The meeting is held yearly.
mandarin: 会议每年举行一次。

mandarin: 会议可能要延长到夜里，因为今晚有太多问题要解决。

english: The meeting will deal with these problems.
mandarin: 本次会议将就这些问题作出处理。

mandarin: 这个商人收到了一船茶叶。

mandarin: 这个百万富翁已把他一半的股票移交给他的长子。

mandarin: 部长就局势的最新发展作了另一番解释。

english: The minute a man is convinced that he is interesting, he is not.
mandarin: 当一个人一旦认为自己是有意思的时候，他就不再是有意思的人了。

english: The miraculous survival of some people in the air crash was widely reported by the press.
mandarin: 空难事件中有些人大难不死被新闻界广泛报导。

english: The monitor collected the exercise books after the class was over.
mandarin: 下课后，班长把练习册收了起来。

english: The moon revolves around the earth.
mandarin: 月球绕地球运行。

english: The morphine was administered by injection
mandarin: 那吗啡是注射进去的.

english: The mountain peaks are covered with snow all year.
mandarin: 山顶上终年积雪。

english: The multitude may laugh at his music, but we know better.
mandarin: 一般人也许会嘲笑他的音乐，但我们更了解它。

english: The needle pierced her finger.
mandarin: 针刺进了她的手指。

english: The new buds appear in the spring.
mandarin: 春天嫩芽初绽。

mandarin: 新法令授予警察可以在街上截停任何人的权利。

english: The new store is crowded with customers.
mandarin: 这家新开的商店里挤满了顾客。

english: The new system has had a disastrous effect on productivity.
mandarin: 新制度已对生产力造成了灾难性的影响。

english: The new theory of the origin of the universe was pulled to pieces by many of the world leading astronomers.
mandarin: 关于宇宙起源的新理论被世界上很多著名的天文学家批得体无完肤。

english: The news greatly surprised them.
mandarin: 这消息使他们大为吃惊。

english: The news of the radiation leak caused widespread public alarm.
mandarin: 辐射泄露的消息引起了公众的普遍恐慌。

english: The newspaper article provided him with fuel for his speech.
mandarin: 报纸上的这篇文章为他的演讲提供了启发。

english: The next postal delivery is at 4 o'clock.
mandarin: 下一次邮递时间是四点钟。

english: The noise of cars passing along the road is a continual disturbance to our quiet at home.
mandarin: 马路上来往的车辆声音不断地破坏我们家的安宁。

english: The Norwegians live in a comparatively cold zone.
mandarin: 挪威人生活在比较寒冷的地区。

english: The novel captured the imagination of thousands of readers.
mandarin: 这部小说引起了千万读者的想象。

english: The novelty of his surroundings soon wore off.
mandarin: 他对环境的新奇感不久就淡薄了。

english: The number of your finger is ten.
mandarin: 你双手手指的总数是10。

english: The old man kept his savings in the bank.
mandarin: 老人把他的储蓄存在银行里。

english: The old man set off at a quick trot.
mandarin: 老人快步走开了。

mandarin: 我们昨天碰到的那个老工人是李师傅。

mandarin: 他听到的唯一的声音就是那台机器的嗡嗡声。

mandarin: 各反对党指责修建新机场是浪费纳税人的金钱。

mandarin: 组织这样大规模的聚会要花费许多时间和精力。

english: The overseas trade has become the main project.
mandarin: 海外贸易成为主要的项目。

english: The pages aren't in proper order.
mandarin: 这些页数次序不对。

english: The pain increased in intensity.
mandarin: 疼痛越来越剧烈。

english: The painting took his fancy, so he bought it.
mandarin: 这幅画被他看中了，所以他就把他买了下来。

english: The paper turned green as if by magic.
mandarin: 这纸魔术般地变成了绿色。

english: The park is only five minutes from downtown.
mandarin: 这个花园离市中心只有五分钟的路程。

english: The parks of this city are famous for their ornate fountains.
mandarin: 这个城市的公园以其华丽的喷泉而著名。

english: The peasants are reaping a field of barley.
mandarin: 农民们正在收割大麦。

english: The performance was immense.
mandarin: 演出极为成功。

english: The picture showed a charming pastoral scene of cows drinking from a stream.
mandarin: 这幅画表现了牛在溪边饮水的迷人的田园风光。

english: The piece of oilcloth is used as a covering for a table.
mandarin: 这块油布是用来铺桌子的。

english: The place continues to fascinate visitors, cloaked in its mystery.
mandarin: 这个地方笼罩在神秘气氛下，继续使游览者着迷。

english: The place is marked on the map with a crossing.
mandarin: 那个地方在地图上以十字形记号标出。

english: The plan is feasible in reason but impractical.
mandarin: 这个计划道理上行得通, 但不现实。

english: The plane stopped in that big hangar.
mandarin: 飞机停在那个大机库里。

english: The plant died for lack of water.
mandarin: 植物因缺水而枯死了。

english: The play came to an end after all.
mandarin: 这场戏总算结束了。

english: The poet has written many poems for her.
mandarin: 那位诗人为她写了许多诗。

english: The poet minted several words that cannot be found in any dictionary.
mandarin: 诗人造了几个词典里找不到的词。

english: The police are on the run to catch the murderer.
mandarin: 警方正在忙着捕捉逃犯。

english: The police are responsible for the enforcement of the law.
mandarin: 警察负责执法。

english: The police found some stolen property in the thief's house.
mandarin: 警察在小偷的家里发现了一些被盗的财物。

mandarin: 警方还未得到可捉拿这个罪犯的足够情报。

mandarin: 警方查获了各种书和磁带.

mandarin: 这个政治家发现饥饿的孩子们可怜的哭声让人不忍心听下去。

mandarin: 人民群众普遍反对突然实行的变革。

mandarin: 这里的邮政服务很不可靠。

english: The power of the press is very great.
mandarin: 新闻界的力量非常大。

mandarin: 目前的情况不得再继续下去了.

mandarin: 候任总统将在下周正式就任。

english: The priest makes pastoral visits every Tuesday.
mandarin: 牧师每星期二作履行神职的访问。

mandarin: 犯人从大门口的警卫身旁溜过逃走了.

mandarin: 问题是什么时候能得到我们所需要的钱。

mandarin: 最近的丑闻给政府的反对派提供了大量的炮弹。

mandarin: 香山红叶是北京最浓最浓的秋色。

mandarin: 这张地图上的红线代表铁路。

mandarin: 该报告建议安全标准应该改进。

mandarin: 这名记者因为试图揭露一个阴谋而被杀害。

mandarin: 这家饭店除星期一外, 每天都营业.

mandarin: 拉丁语系, 例如法语, 意大利语, 都起源于拉丁语。

mandarin: 这房间长15英尺，宽10英尺。

mandarin: 房间里挤满了客人。

mandarin: 生日晚会之后, 房间里一片混乱。

mandarin: 这条路线旅行的人以前常走，但是现在已不用了。

mandarin: 销售经理想在远东开辟新市场。

mandarin: 他把花茎折断，汁液就流了出来。

english: The scene shifted to a sepulcher.
mandarin: 镜头转换到一座坟墓。

english: The school was closed because of the flu.
mandarin: 因为流行性感冒全校停止上课。

english: The scientist is distinguished in many spheres of knowledge.
mandarin: 这位科学家在许多知识领域中都是杰出的。

english: The sea covers nearly three-fourths of the world's surface.
mandarin: 海洋几乎占地球表面的四分之三。

english: The seal on the bottle has perished
mandarin: 瓶子的封记已经腐烂.

english: The security of the whole operation has been jeopardized by one careless person
mandarin: 整个作业的安全让一个粗心大意的人给破坏了.

english: The sentry challenged the stranger at the gates
mandarin: 哨兵查问在门口的陌生人.

english: The setting sun gilds the sky.
mandarin: 落日把天空染成金色。

english: The setting sun had boundless beauty, Just because the yellow dusk is so near.
mandarin: 夕阳无限好，只是近黄昏。

english: The sheep were herded into a ragged line.
mandarin: 这些羊被赶在一起，排成歪歪扭扭的一行。

english: The sheets have worn thin in the middle.
mandarin: 床单的中间部分磨薄了。

mandarin: 船搁浅了--这河口的水比我们想像的要浅.

english: The ship made slow progress through the rough sea.
mandarin: 船只在汹涌的大海中缓慢前进。

english: The ship sank in four fathoms.
mandarin: 这条船沉下四英寻。

english: The ship was anchored athwart at the harbor mouth.
mandarin: 轮船横着停泊在港口里。

mandarin: 那店员一点也不怕麻烦。

mandarin: 签定这一协议是两国关系加强的序幕。

english: The sky slowly changed from blue to red.
mandarin: 天空慢慢由蓝色变为红色。

english: The sky turned dark as the storm came near.
mandarin: 暴风雨来临时，天空转暗。

english: The small shallow boat is called a cockle.
mandarin: 那种浅底小船叫小舟。

english: The snow is two feet in depth.
mandarin: 雪深两英尺。

english: The soil is too dry for planting.
mandarin: 土太干了，不能种东西。

english: The sojourner has been in Wales for two weeks.
mandarin: 那个寄居者在威尔士已经逗留了两个星期。

english: The soldiers sang a song of victory, describing their prowess in battle.
mandarin: 战士们唱起了歌颂他们英勇战斗的凯歌。

english: The soles of my shoes are broken.
mandarin: 我的鞋底都断了。

english: The sonorous voice of the priest resounded in the church.
mandarin: 教士那圆润低沉的声音在教堂里回响。

english: The sound was very discordant.
mandarin: 那种声音很刺耳。

english: The spacecraft is orbiting the moon.
mandarin: 宇宙飞船正绕月球飞行。

english: The speaker has no other purpose except to make people laugh.
mandarin: 这位演说者除了想搞笑之外，没有别的目的。

english: The speech was most disappointing; it skirted round all the main questions.
mandarin: 这篇演讲非常令人失望，它回避了所有主要的问题。

english: The speeches occupied three hours
mandarin: 发言共占去三小时.

english: The station is a short walk from my house
mandarin: 车站到我家只有几步路的路程。

english: The steaming cake was a bait for the hungry boy.
mandarin: 那热气腾腾的蛋糕对这个饥饿的男孩是个诱惑。

english: The stream takes a sudden bend to the east.
mandarin: 小溪突然转向东流。

english: The street is illumined by many lights.
mandarin: 许多灯照亮了街道。

english: The student's speedy answers were praised by the teacher.
mandarin: 这个学生敏捷的回答得到了老师的表扬。

english: The students are working on a mathematical problem.
mandarin: 学生们正在解一道数学习题。

english: The students began to feel homesick after they had been here for a month.
mandarin: 到了这里一个月以后，学生们开始想家了。

english: The students take the admonition from their teacher.
mandarin: 学生们接受老师的劝告。

english: The students were fascinated by his ideas.
mandarin: 学生们都被他的思想吸引住了。

english: The sum of 5 and 3 is 8.
mandarin: 五加三的总和是八。

english: The sun was shining in our faces.
mandarin: 太阳光直射在我们脸上。

english: The sun, the stars and the moon are celestial bodies.
mandarin: 太阳，星星和月亮都是天体。

english: The surgeon asked him if he felt nervous.
mandarin: 外科医生问他是否感到紧张。

english: The symptoms of this disease are fever and sickness
mandarin: 这种病的症状是发烧与呕吐.

english: The table legs are screwed to the floor.
mandarin: 这张桌子的腿是用螺丝固定在地板上的。

english: The tables were laid lengthwise.
mandarin: 这些餐桌是纵向摆放的。

english: The tax laws are so complicated that only an expert can provide enlightenment.
mandarin: 税务法非常复杂，只有专家才能解释清楚。

english: The teacher asked me to note down the main points of the speech.

english: They went out for a walk on the gravelled path.
mandarin: 他们在碎石小径上散步。

english: They were bluffed into believing we were not ready for the attack
mandarin: 他们上了当, 以为我们还没有作好进攻准备.

english: They were girding for the exam.
mandarin: 他们正在准备考试。

english: They were having a fierce argument and I thought they might hit each other.
mandarin: 他们正在恶狠狠地争吵，我想他们可能要打架了。

english: They will go to the zoo or play volleyball.
mandarin: 他们要去动物园或打排球。

english: They will grumble about having to do the work.
mandarin: 他们将为不得不干那项工作而抱怨。

english: They would rather go fishing than stay at home.
mandarin: 他们宁愿去钓鱼，也不愿待在家里。

english: They're fond of holding what are laughingly known as literary soirees
mandarin: 他们爱举行戏称之为文学晚会的活动.

english: Things will change under the new regime.
mandarin: 在新政权下，事情将会发生变化。

english: This affair is within his jurisdiction.
mandarin: 这件事情在他的管辖权限之内。

english: This book gives a good picture of life in China 100 hundred years ago.
mandarin: 这本书形象地描写了一百年前的中国生活。

english: This book is an expansion of the play he wrote before.
mandarin: 这本书是他以前写的剧本的扩充。
